Once inside the main entrance (ground level), continue down the interior route to the Oberndorf Family Auditorium (Room 111) and Lecture Hall 114, which is accessible via an interior ramp at the west end of the building. There are also accessible routes on either side of the building leading to the Biology Quad and an exterior back patio with entrances to the 2nd floor and/or ramps leading to the ground floor. Power-operated doors are located on the rear south side (2nd floor) and side (ground) entrances.

buildings.name: SCHWAB RESIDENTIAL CENTER
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance to the Schwab Residential Center is located along Serra Street and is equipped with a power-operated door. A reception area is just inside and another set of doors beyond the reception area, also equipped with a power-operated door, lead to the exterior courtyard and common areas.

buildings.name: SCRA - SPORT COMPLEX
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance to SCRA is accessible. Once inside, an elevator is located on the left and provides access to all floors (2, 1). Beyond the main entrance, a pathway leads to the pool and the locker rooms are to the right. An exterior door on the 2nd floor leads to a community room.

buildings.name: SEQUOIA HALL
buildings.accessibleEntrance: There are two accessible entrances to Sequoia Hall. The main entrance is located on the northeast side of the building (across from the Main Quad). It is accessible via a ramp to the left of the front steps and is equipped with a power-operated door. The elevator is located just to the left once inside the main entrance. The second accessible entrance is located on the backside of the building, across from the Varian Physics Lab, on Via Pueblo.

buildings.name: SHRIRAM CENTER
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main public entrances to the Shriram Center are equipped with power-operated doors and are located on the south side of the building (across from Y2E2) via pathways from the SEQ Courtyard. The amphitheater-style classroom is accessible via a power-operated door near the southwest corner of the building. Once inside this entrance, wheelchair access is limited to the 1st floor. To access other floors of the building, exit the amphitheater-style classroom and enter the building through the main entrance, heading north along the pathway. There are two elevators in the building: one is located to the left once inside the main entrance and the other at the northeast corner of the building. Elevators provide access to all floors of the building (B, 1, 2, 3). At the basement level, an interior corridor connects the Shriram Center to the Spilker Engineering & Applied Sciences building.

buildings.name: SKILLING (HUGH HILDRETH) BUILDING
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The Skilling classrooms located on the upper level are accessible via the wheelchair ramp near Durand. The main entrance of the Skilling Auditorium (lower level) is wheelchair accessible. Wheelchair seating is located in the front and rear of the auditorium. There is no elevator providing interior access between the upper and lower levels of the building.

buildings.name: SPILKER ENGINEERING & APPLIED SCI.
buildings.accessibleEntrance: All entrances to the building are wheelchair accessible. The main entrance is located on the south side of the building (across from Huang Building) and is equipped with a power-operated door. Additional entrances are located on the south side of the building and another entrance is located on the west side of the building. Once inside the main entrance, an elevator is located to the right and provides access to all floors (SB, B, 1, 2, and 3). Another elevator is located near the northwest corner of the building, but access is limited to the 1st floor, SR (loading area), and basement levels. At the basement level, an interior corridor connects the Spilker Building to the Huang Building and the Shriram Center.

buildings.name: STANFORD FEDERAL CREDIT UNION
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance of the building is located at the northwest corner of the building and is equipped with a power-operated door.

buildings.name: STANFORD STADIUM
buildings.accessibleEntrance: All gate entrances to the Stanford Stadium are accessible. Once inside the gate, the lower bowl reserved wheelchair seating is located via the accessible tunnels, and the upper bowl reserved wheelchair seating is located via the elevator near Gates 4 and/or 5. Assistive listening devices are available at the Guest Services Station located at the south end of the stadium on the Main Concourse level near Section 104.

buildings.name: STAUFFER I - CHEMISTRY
buildings.accessibleEntrance: There are two accessible entrances, one at the southwest corner of the building near the Gazebo, and the other at the east end of the building.Once inside the east entrance, an elevator is located on the left that provides access to all floors (B, 1, 2).

buildings.name: STAUFFER II-PHYSICAL CHEMISTRY
buildings.accessibleEntrance: There are two accessible entrances, one at the west end of the building (North-South Axis) and the other at the east end of the building. Both entrances are equipped with power-operated doors.Once inside the east entrance, there is an elevator located on the left that provides access to all floors of the building (B, 1, 2).

buildings.name: STEUBER STADM/DOYLE CLUBHSE (RUGBY)
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance to the Steuber Rugby Stadium is accessible and located on the west side of the stadium with direct access to the bleachers. Wheelchair seating is located just beyond the main entrance near the fence line, in front of the first row of the bleachers.

buildings.name: STUDENT SERVICES/CAREER DEVELOPMENT CENTER
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance to the Student Services Building, equipped with a power-operated door, is located on Salvatierra Walk. The elevator is located directly inside the main entrance and provides access to all floors (1, 2, 3).

buildings.name: SWEET HALL
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance, equipped with a power-operated door, is accessible via a pathway located to the right of the stairs. An elevator is located to the left of the entrance and provides access to all floors (4, 3, 2, 1, B). Interior doors on each floor leading into the departmental office area are equipped with a power-operated door. The exterior patio is accessible via the elevator to the basement level.

buildings.name: TERMAN ENGINEERING CENTER
buildings.accessibleEntrance: There are two entrances on the north side (Escondio Mall) that are accessible, however the path of travel is up an incline.Once inside, the elevator is to the left, down the hall. On the northeast side of the building (facing the Clock Tower), the entrance is equipped with a power-operated door.Once inside, proceed down the hallway and through a door in order to access the elevator to the 2nd floor. While the entrance on the southeast side of the building is accessible, there is no access to other parts of the building. The rear entrance from Panama Mall is also accessible and closest to the elevator accessing all floors (G, 1, 2).

buildings.name: THE NITERY (BLDG 590)
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The Nitery has several accessible entrances. The south entrance, accessible via a ramp from the center courtyard of Old Union, is equipped with a power-operated door. Once inside (level 1A), the Nitery Theater is directly to the left, and the elevator is located a short distance to the right. Once inside the elevator, all (A) levels open on the panel side of the elevator and all (B) levels open opposite the panel. The elevator accesses the following levels:1A: Access to Nitery Theater1B: Access to various meeting rooms2A: Access to various meeting rooms2B: Access to various meeting roomsGA: Access to wheelchair lift to lowest level of Nitery.GB: Access to various meeting rooms / officesAnother accessible entrance is located on the east side of the building via an accessible pathway from White Plaza. Once inside (level GB), the elevator is a short distance and to the right.

buildings.name: THORNTON CENTER (TERMAN ANNEX)
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance to the building is located via the accessible pathway from Santa Teresa Street. The accessible entrances to the building are located in the central area of the building on the ground level. An alternate accessible route from Samuel Morris Way is an accessible ramp, located on the north side of the building.There are doors that lead directly to the lecture halls and an outdoor elevator that leads to the 2nd floor.

buildings.name: TOWER HOUSE
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance to the Tower House is accessible via a pathway once beyond a front gate.

buildings.name: TRAITEL BUILDING
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance of the Traitel building is located off of Lasuen Mall and is equipped with a power-operated door. Once inside, an indoor lounge area is located to the left and the reception area is to the right. From there, Hauck Auditorium is through a set of doors to the right. Blount Hall is down the hall beyond the reception area. There are also two accessible entrances at the rear of the building, which are both equipped with power-operated doors. From the parking area on Crothers Way, use the ramp behind Hoover Tower. There is also an accessible route between the Art Gallery and Traitel that has a ramp leading to the outdoor courtyard area. The elevator is located just beyond the reception desk and provides access to all floors (00, 1, 2). Note that card reader access is required to access all other levels of the building.

buildings.name: TRESIDDER MEMORIAL UNION
buildings.accessibleEntrance: There are many accessible points of entry to Tresidder Union. For a detailed floor plan, please visit http://studentaffairs.stanford.edu/tresiddermeeting/room/maps-plansAccessible pathways are located on the east side of the building from White Plaza and on the west side of the building from the Humanities Center. Nearly all of the 1st floor entrances are equipped with power-operated doors. Accessible entrances to shops located on the south side of Tresidder (CoHo, Campus Bike Shop) are accessible via entrances on the west side of the building (back patio seating area). There is a wheelchair accessible ramp on the south side of the building (Lagunita Drive) and an elevator on the west side of the building (near the Treehouse) to access the 2nd floor of Tresidder. The Oak Lounge and other meeting spaces are located on the 2nd floor at the north end of Tresidder. Once off the elevator, turn left and continue a short distance. Turn left again and follow the pathway to the exterior entrance, equipped with a power-operated door, to access the Oak Lounge and other meeting rooms.

buildings.name: VADEN STUDENT HEALTH CENTER
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance to Vaden is accessible. An additional accessible entrance is located on the west side of the building, near the disabled parking. Both entrances are equipped with power-operated doors. The elevator is located on the right once inside the main entrance and provides access to all floors (3, 2, 1).

buildings.name: VARIAN (RUSSELL H.) PHYSICS LAB
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance is located on Via Pueblo Mall and is not accessible. The accessible entrance is located at the northeast corner of the building (across from the Main Quad) via a ramp near a set of stairs. At the top of the ramp, proceed through the exterior courtyard between Varian and Physics & Astrophysics to the accessible entrance. Once inside the Varian entrance, an interior hallway connects to Physics & Astrophysics on the left; turn right to enter the rest of Varian Physics. An elevator is located on the right side of the hallway and provides access to all floors (B, 1, 2, 3, 4). There is also an accessible route and entrance via the loading dock at the rear of the building and through to physics stockroom (not a public entrance).

buildings.name: VENTURA HALL
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance to Ventura Hall is accessible and equipped with a power-operated door. Wheelchair accessibility is limited to the 1st floor because there is no elevator in the building.

buildings.name: VISITOR CENTER
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance of the building is located on the west side of the building and is equipped with a power-operated door. The entrance on the east side of the building, facing Angell Field, is also accessible.

buildings.name: WILLIAM H. NEUKOM BUILDING
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance to the Neukom building is located near the rotunda on the north side of the building near the back end of the Law school. Once inside, the elevator is down the hall and on the left side after turning right. An additional accessible entrance is located on the northwest side of the building. From the disabled parking on Lane A, follow the accessible pathway to the entrance and the elevator is just to the left once inside the entrance. Another accessible entrance is located on the southeast side of the building via the exterior walkway between the east and west sides of the building. Once inside this entrance, there is an elevator immediately on the left. The east and west sides of the building can be accessed through interior walkways on the 2nd and 3rd floors. The 2nd floor exterior lounge/terrace is wheelchair accessible.

buildings.name: WILLIAM R. HEWLETT TEACHING CENTER
buildings.accessibleEntrance: There are two accessible entrances to the building, both equipped with power-operated doors. The main entrance is located along the northeast side of the building (Jane Stanford Way) via an accessible pathway leading to a ramp in front of the building. Another accessible entrance is located at the rear of the building via an accessible pathway along Via Pueblo. The elevator is located directly to the right once inside the main entrance. There is wheelchair accessible seating in each of the two classrooms, which are located on the 1st and 2nd floors.

buildings.name: WINDHOVER
buildings.accessibleEntrance: The main entrance to Windhover is accessible via a decomposed granite route (along the west side of the building) and is equipped with a power-operated door. Once inside the building, occupants navigate between several rooms housing artwork. The reflection pool, located at the back of the building, is accessible by continuing on the exterior pathway beyond the main entrance or via an interior door. The labyrinth is accessible via a decomposed granite route in front of the building.

buildings.name: ZAMBRANO HALL / NORTH BUILDING
buildings.accessibleEntrance: There are several wheelchair accessible points of entry to the Knight Management Center¿s seven buildings. There are wheelchair accessible ramps at the front of the Knight Management Center (between the McClelland Building and the MBA Class of 1968 Building) and at the rear of the Center (between the Bass Center and the Faculty Building West/Faculty Building East). There is also a ramp located to the east of Patterson Building (along Serra Street) and on Arguello Way just beyond the Gunn Building. Additionally, elevator access from the underground garage to the 1st floor provides an accessible pathway to all building entrances.The CEMEX Auditorium is located on the west side of the building and the Arbuckle Café and Dining Pavilion are located on the east side of the building. There are two accessible entrances to the CEMEX Auditorium. The furthest east entrance (closest to Arbuckle Café) is equipped with a power-operated door. Once inside, wheelchair seating is centrally located. Additional wheelchair seating is located on the 2nd floor of the CEMEX Auditorium. In order to access the upper level of the Auditorium, take the elevator to the 2nd floor and enter through the exterior entrance. There are two entrances to the Arbuckle Café and Dining Pavilion (east and west side) and both are equipped with power-operated doors. There are elevators on either side of the entrances to Arbuckle Café that provide access to all floors of Zambrano Hall (B, 1, 2, 3).
